community_list_entries.name: MemSecBench: Tracking Agent Memory Poisoning from Persistence to Consequence and Repair

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A lifecycle security benchmark for memory poisoning: 310 cases with a Write-Execute-Forget protocol across 24 configurations (OpenClaw and Hermes harnesses; Native, Mem0, Mem0-Graph and A-MEM backends). The harnesses are general personal agents, not coding agents, and 'Code and Science' is only one
